instructors.name: Abdirahmaan Yusuf
instructors.description: A passionate frontend instructor who simplifies web technologies for Somali learners.
instructors.about: Abdirahmaan waa macallin hore u taagan oo ku xeeldheer HTML, CSS, iyo JavaScript. Wuxuu xooga saaraa dhisidda xirfadaha aasaasiga ah ee frontend-ka si ardaydu ay si fudud u fahmaan sida web-ku u shaqeeyo.

instructors.name: Samafale Mohamed
instructors.description: A fullstack instructor guiding Somali learners through modern technologies.
instructors.about: Samafale waa macallin Fullstack ah oo baraya Node.js, Express, iyo React si uu ardayda uga dhigo kuwa dhisa codsiyo dhamaystiran.

instructors.name: Khadra Ahmed
instructors.description: Creative designer focusing on user experience and modern interfaces.
instructors.about: Khadra waa naqshadeeye ku takhasustay Figma, UX, iyo prototyping, iyadoo diiradda saarta naqshadaha isticmaale-saaxiibka ah.

instructors.name: Mohamed Ali
instructors.description: Specialist in backend development and database management.
instructors.about: Mohamed wuxuu barayaa Node.js, SQL, iyo API development si ardaydu u bartaan xagga server-ka iyo kaydinta xogta.

instructors.name: Ayaan Abdullahi
instructors.description: Expert Python developer and data enthusiast.
instructors.about: Ayaan waa baraya Python-ka, automation, iyo Django framework, iyadoo diiradda saarta codsiyada backend-ka iyo xogta.

instructors.name: Yusuf Omar
instructors.description: Security-focused instructor with ethical hacking expertise.
instructors.about: Yusuf wuxuu barayaa ilaalinta amniga, hacking-ka sharci ah, iyo farsamooyinka difaaca nidaamyada.

instructors.name: Hodan Warsame
instructors.description: Data-driven instructor passionate about analytics and visualization.
instructors.about: Hodan waxay baraysaa Excel, Power BI, iyo Python si loo fahmo xogta iyo go’aan qaadashada xog ku saleysan.

instructors.name: Ali Hassan
instructors.description: Expert in Android and iOS app development.
instructors.about: Ali wuxuu diiradda saarayaa dhisidda barnaamijyo casri ah oo mobile ah isagoo isticmaalaya Flutter iyo React Native.

instructors.name: Fatima Noor
instructors.description: Teaches automation, deployment, and cloud technologies.
instructors.about: Fatima waxay baraysaa CI/CD pipelines, Docker, iyo AWS si ardaydu u bartaan sida loo maamulo software-ka casriga ah.

instructors.name: Omar Farah
instructors.description: AI instructor passionate about deep learning and neural networks.
instructors.about: Omar waa injineer AI ah oo diiradda saaraya barashada mashiinka, TensorFlow, iyo codsiyada caqliga macmalka ah.
